file_change.purpose: Resolve and mechanically validate canonical Markdown Design Proposals and selected DP statements.
implementation: Parse the YAML-like metadata header using a minimal deterministic parser for the known Design Proposal metadata keys.
Verify doc_id format, artifact_type, canonical_format, dependencies, exact 16 level-two headers in canonical order, stable Section ID values, and unique DP statement IDs.
Resolve declared proposal dependencies from the functional-set Design inputs.
Given a functional-set Design input, verify path, exact revision token, doc_id, and existence/ownership of every selected statement.
Return a non-normative DesignIndex containing addresses and source locations only.
Expose a Design Assurance subject summary containing exact proposal revision, declared dependencies, section completeness, and statement index without deciding semantic readiness mechanically.
